name: io.github.slobaloncar/livelaunch
title: LiveLaunch
description: LiveLaunch MCP: 9 tools to list, quote, and build unsigned launch, buy, sell, and fee-claim txs.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: API and Solana RPC health: slot, version, and the LiveLaunch config addresses. No transaction is built.

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Publicly listed LiveLaunch tokens. Mainnet test tokens and admin-hidden tokens are omitted. Each row includes mint, pool, price, market cap, curve progress, currentFeeBps, and protectionEndsAt. A hidden token is still available from get_token.

creator.description: Only tokens created by this wallet.

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: One LiveLaunch token, including a test token that is hidden from lists. Price, market cap, curve progress, current fee, launch protection, creator links, and unclaimed creator fees. testToken is true when it is off public lists. Read currentFeeBps and protectionEndsAt before trading.

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: Fee model for new launches, including the current bonding-curve fee, launch protection, the Meteora / creator / platform split, and graduated (the DAMM v2 split from that config's locked LP). For a specific token, use get_token.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Quote a buy (amount is SOL) or a sell (amount is tokens). Returns expectedOut, minOut, the pool fee, and poolFee.protectionEndsAt. Does not build or send a transaction.

mint.description: Base58 Solana address. A public key, never a private key.

amount.description: Buy: SOL, e.g. 0.1. Sell: token UI amount. Optional when lamports or tokenAmountRaw is set.

lamports.description: Buy only: SOL amount in lamports.

tokenAmount.description: Sell: token UI amount. Same as amount.

tokenAmountRaw.description: Sell: token amount in base units.

wallet.description: Trader public key. The streamer fee is skipped when this wallet is the streamer.

tools.name: build_launch_tx
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED launch transaction (token, metadata, Meteora bonding-curve pool, optional creator first buy). Pass mint as the public key of a keypair you generated and sign with that keypair too. If mint is omitted the server generates one and pre-signs only that mint key; the secret is not returned. Does not broadcast.

creator.description: Creator wallet public key. This wallet must sign.

imageUrl.description: https image. Required unless metadataUri is set.

initialBuySol.description: Creator first buy, in the launch transaction. 0 to skip.

mint.description: Public key of a fresh mint keypair you will also sign with.

skipSimulationCheck.description: Return the unsigned transaction even if simulation fails.

priorityFeeMicroLamports.description: Priority fee override in micro-lamports per compute unit.

tools.name: build_buy_tx
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED buy transaction for a LiveLaunch bonding curve. solAmount is decimal SOL. Sign locally with wallet. Does not broadcast.

mint.description: Base58 Solana address. A public key, never a private key.

wallet.description: Buyer public key. This wallet must sign.

lamports.description: SOL amount in lamports, instead of solAmount.

skipSimulationCheck.description: Return the unsigned transaction even if simulation fails.

priorityFeeMicroLamports.description: Priority fee override in micro-lamports per compute unit.

tools.name: build_sell_tx
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED sell transaction. Pass tokenAmount, tokenAmountRaw, or percent (1–100) of the wallet balance. Sign locally with wallet. Does not broadcast.

mint.description: Base58 Solana address. A public key, never a private key.

wallet.description: Seller public key. This wallet must sign.

tokenAmount.description: Tokens to sell, decimal UI amount.

percent.description: Sell this percent of the wallet balance.

skipSimulationCheck.description: Return the unsigned transaction even if simulation fails.

priorityFeeMicroLamports.description: Priority fee override in micro-lamports per compute unit.

tools.name: build_claim_creator_fees_tx
tools.description: Build UNSIGNED transactions that claim creator fees for one LiveLaunch pool. Before graduation this is the bonding-curve creator fee. After graduation it also claims DAMM v2 fees on the creator's permanently locked position, plus any leftover bonding-curve fees. Sign every transaction in transactions (transaction is the first). Does not broadcast.

creator.description: Pool creator public key. This wallet must sign.

mint.description: Token mint. Use this or pool.

pool.description: Meteora DBC pool address. Use this or mint.

skipSimulationCheck.description: Return the unsigned transaction even if simulation fails.

priorityFeeMicroLamports.description: Priority fee override in micro-lamports per compute unit.
